title: EEP Agent Wallet Binding Declaration
description: Schema for the Agent Wallet Binding Declaration — a signed document declaring how an agent's operational DID is bound to its cryptographic key store. Three binding models are defined per Whitepaper §8: operator-derived (BIP-32 HD), hardware-isolated (TEE/HSM), and OS-keychain (Secure Enclave / Android Keystore / Windows CNG). This document is stored in the agent's local secure configuration and can be presented to publishers requiring it.

agent_did.description: The operational DID derived from this wallet. This is the identity the agent uses in all EEP interactions.

binding_model.description: The key binding model. 'operator_derived' = BIP-32 HD derivation from operator master seed. 'hardware_isolated' = TEE/HSM-bound key, never extractable. 'os_keychain' = OS Secure Enclave / Keystore / CNG.

key_type.description: The cryptographic key type used for this wallet's DID private key.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this wallet binding was created.

rotation_policy.description: Key rotation policy. EEP recommends 90-day proactive rotation.

max_age_days.description: Maximum key age in days before rotation is required. Recommended: 90.

auto_rotate.description: If true, the agent automatically rotates the key when max_age_days is reached without human confirmation.

next_rotation_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the next scheduled rotation (informational).

delegation_scope.description: If this is a delegated session key, this block describes the scope granted by the master DID. Absent for master keys.

master_did.description: The master DID that signed the delegation credential.

delegation_credential_id.description: W3C VC ID of the Delegation Proof credential issued by the master DID.

permitted_gate_types.description: Gate types this session key is permitted to satisfy.

permitted_endpoints.description: Optional allowlist of endpoint URL patterns this key may interact with.

max_payment_amount_usd.description: Maximum payment amount in USD-equivalent that this session key may authorize per transaction.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC expiry time of this delegation scope. Session keys should have short validity (e.g., 8h).

operator_derived_config.description: Present only when binding_model = 'operator_derived'. BIP-32 derivation configuration.

derivation_path.description: BIP-32 HD derivation path used to derive this agent's key from the operator master seed.

master_did.description: The operator's master DID from which this agent key is derived.

hardware_config.description: Present only when binding_model = 'hardware_isolated'. TEE/HSM configuration.

attestation_endpoint.description: URL where remote attestation reports can be fetched to verify TEE integrity.

os_keychain_config.description: Present only when binding_model = 'os_keychain'. OS keychain configuration.

biometric_required.description: If true, biometric authentication is required to access this key.

operator_did.description: DID of the human or organization that operates and controls this agent.

pqc_ready.description: Indicates whether this wallet is configured for hybrid post-quantum signing (EdDSA + ML-DSA).
